name: Emotions
use_when: Use when feelings should stay with the characters between scenes and push them to act on them (drama, romance, teen heroes).

afraid.clear: admit the fear out loud to someone, or step back from a fight that matters

angry.clear: say the cruel thing, or break something that belongs to whoever caused it

guilty.clear: confess, or pay for it with something they value

hopeless.clear: give up on something for an easy comfort tonight

insecure.clear: do something reckless, alone, to prove they can
